posts.text: Having ADHD in a minority household meant thriving looked like hiding.
My ADHD budget has a section for ‘oops.’ Anyone else?
My ADHD brain forgets what I’m doing halfway through doing it and I’ve stopped trying to fight it.
I stopped calling it procrastination. Now it’s ‘creative buffering.’
My ADHD brain: “Let’s fix our life.” Also my ADHD brain: spends 4 hours organizing icons on the desktop.
You’re not lazy. You’re adapting to a world not built for your brain.
